profilePage.title: Profile
profilePage.adminBio:
Tariq Islam Admin is the management and moderation system behind the Tariq Islam platform, created and operated by Busaki Media. It is designed to help oversee the growing Muslim community by managing users, monitoring content, reviewing reports, approving mosque listings, handling events, and maintaining a safe Islamic environment for all members.

The admin system gives full control over community operations, including:

• User management and verification
• Community moderation and content review
• Mosque and event approvals
• Advertisement management
• Reports and complaints handling
• Message monitoring for safety compliance
• Partnership and organization management
• Analytics and engagement tracking

Our mission is to build a secure, beneficial, and global Islamic digital community where Muslims can connect, learn, and grow together while maintaining Islamic values.

Powered by Busaki Media
Building technology for the Ummah.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tariq Islam
welcome.body: Tariq Islam brings worship, learning, trusted scholars, mosques, community, and Islamic AI tools together in one place.

ibadah.title: Begin with Ibadah
ibadah.body: Open Ibadah to access the Quran, Qibla, Tasbih, mosques, scholars, saved lectures, continuing education, and Tariq AI.

reflections.title: Explore Reflections
reflections.body: Watch short Islamic reminders with captions and translations in supported languages.

scholars.title: Learn from Scholars
scholars.body: Follow verified scholars, watch lectures, save lessons, explore playlists, and continue watching later.

mosques.title: Connect with Mosques
mosques.body: Find mosque profiles, announcements, events, prayer information, and in-app livestreams.

ai.title: Use Tariq AI
ai.body: Ask Islamic questions, use the Hajj Assistant and dua library, and translate or summarize Islamic text.

community.title: Join the Community
community.body: Connect with other Muslims through community features, private messaging, groups, and calls.

scholarWelcome.title: Welcome to the Scholar Platform
scholarWelcome.body: Your approved scholar account includes tools for teaching, publishing lectures, organizing playlists, and reaching followers.

scholarProfile.title: Manage Your Scholar Profile
scholarProfile.body: Keep your biography, specialties, languages, location, and public information accurate.

scholarLectures.title: Upload Lectures
scholarLectures.body: Create lecture drafts, add titles and descriptions, upload videos, and prepare content for review.

scholarCaptions.title: Captions and Translation
scholarCaptions.body: Generate timed captions and make lectures accessible through supported caption translations.

scholarReview.title: Submit for Review
scholarReview.body: Submit completed lectures for moderation and track draft, pending, approved, or rejected status.

scholarManage.title: Manage Lectures and Playlists
scholarManage.body: Organize approved lectures into playlists and help followers continue learning from your channel.
